response.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean_avg_remaining FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean_avg_remaining DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL link_to_event are grouped together as one group (a NULL 'event') and included. Budget lines with a NULL event link are not excluded.
The mean of per-event average remaining values ignores events whose average remaining is NULL (all remaining values missing), and each event counts once.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily.
